say:3:1623499003:0.text: The article is sharp and detailed. It strings the evidence together, showing how a lot of the "big reveals" were actually lies, then digs into how the story was twisted on purpose, and what the people behind it were trying to achieve.

say:4:1623499004:0.text: This one doesn't dwell on the scandal itself. It asks bigger questions—what magic is supposed to be, what teaching is supposed to do, and how the Lyceum can move past this and actually come out better on the other side.
